reviewed_sources.contract: Write append sentinel -1, constrained EOF, actual accepted count and FileInfo on success.
FspFileSystemOpWrite derives append from UINT64_MAX and copies count and complete FileInfo only on successful synchronous completion.

decision: Preserve the already-qualified 2026 prerelease SDK and unchanged ABI; this feature adds optional native advice, not a new Windows API. Do not confuse the stable-only latest endpoint with newest prerelease.
